I’d love to help you map out your trip! To make sure I give you the most useful info, could you tell me a bit more about your plans?

1️⃣ **Departure & Arrival**  
   • When do you intend to leave Rivermist?  
   • Do you have a target arrival time in San Francisco?

2️⃣ **Route Preferences**  
   • Are you looking for the fastest route, scenic detours, or a mix?  
   • Any particular highways or towns you’d like to pass through or avoid?

3️⃣ **Stops & Breaks**  
   • Will you be stopping for meals, refueling, or sightseeing along the way?  
   • How many breaks per day would you prefer?

4️⃣ **Vehicle Details**  
   • What’s the make/model and year of your car?  
   • Do you know its average fuel economy (mpg)?

5️⃣ **Other Needs**  
   • Need assistance estimating fuel usage, checking tire pressure, or setting up navigation?  
   • Would you like me to look up nearby gas stations or tire shops at key points?

Once I have those details, I can estimate distances, suggest optimal routes, calculate fuel needs, and even set up navigation for you. Let me know how you’d like to proceed!
